categories.main_business_segments: Huali Industrial Group Company Limited primarily engages in the development, design, production, and sales of sports footwear. Its product portfolio includes sports casual shoes, outdoor boots, sports sandals/slippers, covering various activities such as running, walking, trail, hiking, basketball, skateboarding, and skiing. The company serves global well-known sports and leisure brands including Nike, Adidas, Converse, Vans, UGG, Hoka, On, New Balance, Puma, Asics, Under Armour, Reebok, and Lululemon.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as 3D printing and virtual reality in product and mold development. It has developed proprietary mold technologies including dual-stage opening molds, high-efficiency foam molding, and injection molding for shoe soles. Production involves over 180 processes including cutting, printing, sewing, molding, and assembly, with increasing automation such as intelligent cutting machines and automated forming lines to improve efficiency and quality. The company also focuses on new materials and sustainable manufacturing processes, including supercritical physical foam midsoles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Huali Group's primary customers are global leading sports and leisure brands like Nike, Adidas, Converse, Vans, UGG, and others. The company’s products are sold mainly in the United States, Europe, and other global markets. Its customer base is diversified with no significant dependency on any single client, and it maintains long-term strategic partnerships with major brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases primarily in Vietnam and Indonesia, and sales concentrated in the United States (85% of revenue), Europe (12.75%), and other regions. It has expanded manufacturing capacity in Southeast Asia to mitigate geopolitical risks and optimize cost structures. The company also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Myanmar, and the Dominican Republic.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huali Group operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer in the sports footwear supply chain, focusing on product development, design, and large-scale manufacturing. It collaborates closely with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream brand operators, providing customized production services to global sports brands. The company controls a complete manufacturing chain from molds, shoe uppers, soles to finished products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in mold technology, sole and upper materials, and manufacturing process innovation, with a 2024 R&D expenditure of approximately RMB 375 million. It emphasizes automation, digitalization, and sustainable development, including carbon reduction targets validated by SBTi. Future strategies include expanding production capacity in Vietnam and Indonesia, enhancing automation, developing new materials and technologies, and upgrading information management systems like SAP.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized sports footwear products to global sports brand operators. The company uses a direct sales model with trade terms mainly FOB and FCA. Pricing is based on material costs, labor, manufacturing expenses, and reasonable profit margins, with credit terms typically ranging from 30 to 90 days.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other listed sports footwear manufacturers such as Yue Yuen Industrial Holdings (Yue Yuen Group) and Feng Tay Enterprises. Huali Group is positioned as a global leading specialized sports footwear manufacturer with strong design capabilities, large-scale production, and diversified customer base. It is recognized as a core or strategic supplier to major international sports brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 24.01 billion, a 19.35% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.84 billion, up 20%. It sold 223 million pairs of shoes, a 17.53% increase. Total assets reached RMB 22.76 billion, with net assets of RMB 17.43 billion. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume, revenue, and profitability, supported by capacity expansion and new customer acquisition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huali Group offers comprehensive one-stop sports footwear manufacturing services with strong R&D and design capabilities tailored to global brand requirements. Its competitive advantages include a complete manufacturing chain, advanced automation, high-quality standards, timely delivery, and sustainable production practices. The company emphasizes innovation in materials and processes, cost efficiency through scale, and strong customer relationships to deliver high-performance, fashionable, and environmentally friendly products.
